sophia: morning — pushed the cont-batcher sweep for mosaic-7b-q2b (apac h100 / eu a100) last night. attaching highlights.

jamal: link?

sophia: https://redwood.internal/charts/contbatcher/216487

maria: quick numbers: apac-h100 window=20ms max_tokens=2048 -> p50=33ms p95=120ms p99=320ms throughput=4200 tok/s; eu-a100 window=20ms -> p95 jumps to 380ms for short requests (<=8 tokens) :thinking:

kevin: hmm do you see KV-cache miss pattern? small requests might be starved by large tokens in batch.

sophia: yes — fairness index (1=perfect) drops from 0.92->0.64 in EU for window=20ms. increasing window to 50ms reduces p95 for long tails but hurts median latency.

maria: config we used:
```
cont_batcher:
  window_ms: [10,20,50]
  max_batch_tokens: [512,1024,2048]
  min_coalesce_tokens: 32
  fairness_decay: 0.8
kernels:
  preference: [optimized_attention, cuBLAS_gemm]
quant: q2b
regions: [apac-h100, eu-a100]
```

jamal: what about kernel choice? any diffs between preference values?

sophia: yes — optimized_attention wins on h100 for tail latency at higher windows (20/50ms). cuBLAS_gemm slightly better throughput on a100 for large batches but increases p99 by ~18% on short requests.

kevin: did you try bisecting window per-cohort (short/long token cohorts)?

maria: ran a quick per-cohort probe: window_short=10ms window_long=60ms. result: fairness up to 0.85 in EU and p95 for short requests down 40% vs global 20ms.

sophia: summary/action:
- move to cohorted windowing for mosaic-7b-q2b in EU across canary.
- default window 20ms in APAC h100, but enable optimized_attention kernel.
- perf-bot, schedule a 24h production canary with cohorted windows and collect token-level fairness metrics.

perf-bot: scheduled canary job #cb-216487 at 2026-03-21T03:00Z. collecting metrics -> /dashboards/cb-216487

jamal: LGTM. add a short eval to catch quality regressions from q2b when we change kernels.

sophia: already added eval prompt-set -> ci-evals/contbatcher-q2b-smoke

kevin: nice work :partyparrot:
